context:
2026-10-27: PR #3594 opened (head 68537816b) after the local review gave SHIP with no findings; real #3585 attempt artifacts are test fixtures.

2026-10-27: owner asked why #3585's review escalated from large to huge.
description:
Problem (#3585 head cac6c9cfc, run 40515355448, 2026-10-27T13:57Z): the plain-language doc rewrite pushed the diff past the inline brief cap, so the brief was file-list mode. large (attempt 1) read 8 files and the staged diff, then answered SHIP; evidence.check (file-list mode only) rejected it as incomplete: no direct read of 6 of the 10 required files (4 templates, test_attempts.py, test_cli_plan.py). Attempt 2 got the same brief with no feedback, read the templates but again not the two test files (each a one-line deletion it had seen in the staged diff). selection then advanced to huge (role review, omp @plan), which read 25 files and shipped. The escalation fixed a reading-coverage miss, not a capability limit, at the cost of the most expensive reviewer.
Instruction gaps: (1) the file listing mixes required reads with inert and exempt files (docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md was listed but inert), so the reviewer cannot tell which reads are enforced; (2) the evidence rule is phrased conditionally ('When the change data lists files instead of carrying the diff ...') next to inline-mode wording, and nothing says that reading the staged diff does not count as reading a file or that one-line and low-priority files are included; (3) 'starting with the highest FILE PRIORITY scores' invites skipping low-score files; (4) a retry carries no feedback although evidence.check knows exactly which files were unread.

Outcome: in file-list mode the brief lists the required reads explicitly (the plan's evidence_files), marks other listed files as not required, and states plainly that each required file needs its own read and the staged diff does not substitute. An attempt absent as incomplete because of missing evidence is retried on the same reviewer with a short note naming the unread files (paths only, from the trusted plan, never reviewer text); escalation after such an absence happens only if the retry also misses (or as decided by the Jev recovery item once it lands).

Decision gates:
1. Coordinate with oracle-invalid-attempt-jev-recovery-20261027: evidence-incomplete is deterministic and its fix (name the files) is known, so it does not need Jev; if the two items conflict on selection rules, stop and ask the owner.
2. Retry feedback text must fit the existing brief byte caps; if not, stop and report.

Item guardrails: the evidence requirement itself is not weakened; the retry note carries only trusted plan paths; fail closed.

FREEZE LIFTED (owner 2026-10-27): the oracle-code merge freeze is removed; PRs merge on the normal rules (oracle SHIP on the exact head, threads answered and resolved, make pr-arm).

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge or a ruleset or settings change, and never a stand-in, adjudication or backoff reset unless the owner names the PR and head (and the finding) in the current request after an Owner instruction comment. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, and never post a commit status by hand. Run /oracle-review only on a pending or absent head, or after a Dispute: reply with file:line counter-evidence; never to re-roll a decided head. Do not close, reopen, rerun or rebase other PRs. Until oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-access-20261025 merges, publish only from the owner's Mac. Rollback: if a change to the verdict or gate workflows or to the local review breaks its first live run after merge in a way that blocks other PRs, stop, run make trunk-revert PR=<n>, and report to the owner, who chooses between an absence stand-in and the broken-oracle-gate procedure. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
